name: Fel'zerul
summary: At Stonard, Fel'zerul watches the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar for danger. Thrall has sent him to learn what stirs there.

sections.title: Eyes on the Sunken Temple
sections.body: From Stonard, Fel'zerul watches the corruption around the Pool of Tears and the submerged Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Thrall's Horde is wary of dark arts, yet the Warchief knows their students can help uncover the dangers they hold. So Fel'zerul directs adventurers to recover artifacts and investigate the exiled Atal'ai trolls. He seeks to learn what evil stirs beneath the waters before it threatens the Horde's southern outpost.

faq.answer: Fel'zerul is an orc warlock living in Stonard, the Horde's stronghold in the Swamp of Sorrows. He investigates the dark rituals at the nearby Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

faq.q: Why did Thrall send a warlock to Stonard?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall sent Fel'zerul to Stonard because ancient curses and blood rituals call for knowledge of dark sorceries. Fel'zerul watches the sunken temple and works to protect Horde interests in the swamp.

Fel'zerul investigates the Atal'ai trolls and their rites at the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, by the Pool of Tears. He sends scouts and adventurers to recover artifacts and seek exiled priests who may know its lore.

angles.text: As a warlock, Fel'zerul shows that Thrall's new Horde sometimes relies on practitioners of the dark arts to face obscure, esoteric threats.
At Stonard, Fel'zerul watches for dark magic in the swamp, helping guard the Horde's foothold in the region.
